column1: # ProtocolLib constant name -> PacketEvents constant name.
# ProtocolLib and PacketEvents both name packets after wiki.vg/Mojang, so most constants
# already agree and are matched automatically by the generator (exact name, or PacketEvents'
# wrapper class name matching one of ProtocolLib's declared packet class aliases).
# This file covers only the names that do NOT match automatically. Every row was checked
# against ProtocolLib's own PacketType.java declarations (which carry the Mojang, Spigot and
# legacy class names for each packet) and PacketEvents' wrapper classes. Fuzzy matching was
# deliberately NOT used for these: a wrong packet mapping fails silently at runtime and
# corrupts plugin behaviour, so they are pinned explicitly instead.
# The generator fails the build if any PE_NAME here does not exist, so a PacketEvents upgrade
# that renames a packet surfaces as a build error rather than a silent behaviour change.
# Mojang renamed clientbound pong_response to debug_pong; PacketEvents tracks the new name.
# PacketEvents' CHAT_COMMAND is the signed variant; its CHAT_COMMAND_UNSIGNED is the
# 1.20.5+ unsigned one. ProtocolLib's plain CHAT_COMMAND matches PE's CHAT_COMMAND by name.
# Both ProtocolLib's GROUND (StatusOnly) and FLYING collapse onto PacketEvents' PLAYER_FLYING.
# Mojang renamed serverbound ping_request to debug_ping; PacketEvents tracks the new name.
# Additional historical clientbound names retained by ProtocolLib.
